steps.what: Clarify cargo insurance requirements and confirm customer instructions and authority
Obtain or arrange cargo insurance through authorised parties and verify coverage confirmation

tasks.design: Retain cargo-insurance clarification and authorised arrangement through {EMAIL} or {PARTNER_PORTAL}. The forwarder checks the provider's actual terms and confirmation rather than inferring coverage from a submitted enquiry.
tasks.previous_blocker: Cargo facts, exclusions and authority vary between insurance requests.
tasks.enabler_now: No evidenced change removes this judgement and coordination.
tasks.still_hard: Unclear values, unusual goods and conditions that remain unconfirmed.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising when the request requires provider clarification or specialist referral.
tasks.altitude: The forwarder keeps the same arrangement responsibility without gaining underwriting authority.

reach.task: Provide a complete factual cargo enquiry for authorised review

evidence.claim: Cargo insurance arrangement requires actual requirements and provider confirmation; no supported labour saving is asserted.

assumptions: Boundary is the forwarder's arrangement work, excluding underwriting, specialist advice beyond authority and claims handling. If a cargo agent performs the same arrangement, a roll-up assigns it once.

The customer supplies existing shipment particulars and requested cover before s1. The forwarder clarifies goods, declared value/currency, journey, dates, requested scope and mandate in s1; no ready structured insurance brief is assumed.

The provider produces its terms and response during s2 after receiving the brief. All review, clarification and authorised arrangement time remains counted. Missing or conditional confirmation requires manual follow-up, not a generated coverage statement.
Test existing provider forms for a separately demonstrated entry problem before custom tools; no change is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because the authorised arrangement process remains unchanged.
research_questions: Does a distinct repeated-entry workload exist beyond substantive coverage clarification?

already_counted.description: Requirements and authorised arrangement remain fully counted

incremental.description: No changed system or procedure to maintain

approvals.approved_version: Exact cargo brief, provider terms, customer mandate and communicated arrangement/confirmation; changed conditions require renewed authorised review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net saving 0. The scenario retains actual insurance clarification and coordination without inventing paperwork savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Check detailed port and terminal information relevant to the importer or exporter
Compile the selected port information and source references into a client briefing
Verify and provide the port briefing and explain limitations or changed requirements

tasks.design: Configure a briefing template in {DOCS} that assembles the forwarder's selected current port and terminal facts with their sources. The forwarder checks the exact briefing and explains it through {EMAIL}; the template does not decide which requirements apply or hide validity dates.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selected port facts and references may be copied repeatedly into client messages.
tasks.enabler_now: A fixed briefing layout can reuse checked selections without a model interpreting port requirements.
tasks.still_hard: Different terminal practices, changing cutoffs and shipment-specific exceptions.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguishing general port information from requirements applicable to the client's shipment.
tasks.altitude: The forwarder may assemble fewer briefing documents manually while retaining source selection and explanation responsibility.

reach.task: Provide a current source-linked terminal information pack

evidence.claim: Portbase provides port-document prenotification and import-status information, supporting one relevant information source rather than proving a complete port briefing or local labour gain.

assumptions: Boundary is a detailed port briefing, excluding shipment-status notifications, customs decisions and transport booking. Generic client-explanation overlap is assigned once in a roll-up.

Port and terminal operators publish existing information before s1. The forwarder checks or captures port/terminal identity, relevant service, source title/reference, issue/validity date, exact selected text or fields, applicable cutoffs/access requirements and stated limitations in s1; all selection, capture and clarification remain counted.

S2 assembles only selected material and source references. Missing validity, unclear terminal scope or conflicting requirements require manual clarification; no structured port-policy feed is assumed free.

Test native document templates before custom code. Existing briefing generation earns no new saving. Allow 6 focal hours per 100 baseline for template upkeep, stale-source checks and generation faults.
research_questions: Does template assembly save effort after terminal scope, validity and source-link review?

already_counted.description: Port source selection and applicability checks remain counted
Briefing verification, delivery and explanation remain counted

incremental.description: Maintain briefing template and check stale sources and output faults

approvals.approved_version: Exact port briefing, selected source versions, terminal scope and client recipient; any changed content or source voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=80; gross saving 20 less 6 upkeep gives net 14. Range 1-8 assumes repeated manual assembly today and changing terminal requirements that retain substantial human checking.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify shipment status evidence and confirm the exact notification and permitted recipients
Send the confirmed shipment status notification to exporters, consignees or insurers
Resolve failed notifications and answer shipment status clarification requests

tasks.design: Configure {OPS_SYSTEM} to send an exact forwarder-confirmed status notice through {EMAIL}. The forwarder retains status interpretation, recipient verification and exceptions; no model invents arrival, release or delivery events.
tasks.previous_blocker: Routine notices may be sent manually after the status has already been checked.
tasks.enabler_now: Native notifications can transmit a confirmed message without another composition-and-send pass.
tasks.still_hard: Unreliable events, conflicting statuses and recipients authorised for different information.
tasks.human_edge: Explaining uncertainty and recognising when a recorded event does not support the requested conclusion.
tasks.altitude: The forwarder may send less repetitive mail while retaining status and disclosure responsibility.

reach.task: Resolve a status-notification exception with source evidence

evidence.claim: Portbase provides import-status information; this supports an underlying status source, not proof that every shipment event or recipient is reliable.
Sending an exact confirmed status message through native notifications is plausible; local savings remain unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is shipment-status notification, excluding event production, arrival-specific delivery arrangement and physical shipment execution. A roll-up assigns any duplicate notice once.

Carriers or terminals produce existing event evidence before s1 and the customer/account owner supplies existing contact permissions. The forwarder checks and captures shipment ID, actual event type/time/location, source/version, uncertainty, exact message/template version, permitted recipient/contact and timing in s1. All capture and approval time remain counted.

No structured status code is accepted without source interpretation and no contact list is assumed complete. Missing or conflicting evidence requires manual clarification; unsupported events are not sent.
The mail system produces delivery results after s2 and contacts produce questions after receipt before s3. Reworded or corrected notices require renewed exact-version approval.

Test native notifications before custom integration. Already automated notices earn zero new saving. Allow 8 focal hours per 100 baseline for template upkeep, duplicate-send checks and failures, plus 2 other-role hours for interface access.
unknowns: Status source reliability and notification baseline
research_questions: Do confirmed native notices save effort after source, recipient and duplicate-send checks?

already_counted.description: Status and recipient checks and exact notice approval remain counted
Failed-notice handling and clarification remain counted

incremental.description: Maintain notice configuration and audit duplicates and send failures

approvals.approved_version: Exact confirmed status notice, source event/version, permitted recipient/contact and timing; any change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=65; gross saving 35 less 8 focal upkeep gives net 27. Range 5-16 assumes manual notice transmission remains and unreliable events or contacts require substantial exceptions; already automated notices gain zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify proper packaging and labeling of exported goods against the applicable shipment requirements

tasks.design: Retain the forwarder's verification of actual packaging and labels. Requirements held in {DOCS} support the inspection, but a valid label or complete packing record does not prove physical packaging is adequate.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task requires comparing actual goods and packaging with shipment-specific requirements.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported change removes this physical verification.
tasks.still_hard: Hidden damage, incorrect contents and requirements that vary by cargo and destination.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising an inadequate package even when its paperwork appears complete.
tasks.altitude: The verification role and responsibility for escalating defects remain unchanged.

reach.task: Communicate an observed packaging or label defect for correction
reach.learn: Shipment-specific inspection criteria and escalation limits

evidence.claim: Physical packaging and label verification remains distinct from checking that a record contains the required fields.

assumptions: Boundary is the forwarder's packaging and label verification, excluding packaging manufacture, repacking and specialist certification.

Packing staff produce the actual packaged goods before inspection, while the existing shipper/operator process provides applicable requirements. The forwarder checks their applicability and actual condition within s1's fully retained time.
No ready compliance flag, defect code or image-based safety judgement is assumed. Unclear requirements or inaccessible evidence require manual clarification or specialist referral.
Consider native inspection records for a distinct paperwork problem before custom tools; no changed system is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because verification practice remains unchanged.
unknowns: Forwarder's inspection remit and specialist support
research_questions: Which defects require physical access or specialist evidence beyond a label scan?

already_counted.description: Actual packaging and label verification remain fully counted

incremental.description: No new tool or process to maintain

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net saving 0. The scenario keeps actual export packaging and labeling verification without inventing removable administration.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Port-brief assembly and confirmed status notices may require less repeated work; insurance judgement and physical export checks remain with authorised people.
reach: Resolve shipment-status exceptions using reliable event evidence
role.ambitious_version: Provide clearer, dependable shipment information while keeping cargo facts, coverage confirmation and physical verification explicit.
